scope: Direct PyTorch FC anchor Full only; independent CPU/NPU small tests and finite paired costs, no default-runtime or full-scale strict equivalence claim

resources.admission: idle device, two observations; other cards/host shared with external jobs; no exclusive peak claim

workload_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
src=/dev/shm/gef-fc-batch-full-20261112/after
root=/mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation
out="$root/artifacts/fc-batch-full-20261112"
source "$src/scripts/local_ascend.sh"
tide_load_ascend
py="$root/artifacts/additive-work/env/bin/python"
export PYTHONPATH="$src/python:$src/scripts"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export TIDE_FC_DEVICE="$1"
cd "$out"
if [ "$1" = cpu ]; then
  "$py" -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider "$src/tests/test_fc_full_batch.py" "$src/tests/test_fc_tensor_baseline.py" "$src/tests/test_tensor_baseline_continuation.py" -k 'fc or finite_interval' --dtype both --junitxml="$out/cpu.xml"
  threads=1
  label=cpu
else
  "$py" -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider "$src/tests/test_fc_full_batch.py" "$src/tests/test_fc_tensor_baseline.py" -k 'selected_batch or formula_outputs' --dtype float32 --junitxml="$out/npu.xml"
  threads=2
  label=npu
fi
"$py" "$src/scripts/benchmark_fc_batch_pair.py" --before /dev/shm/gef-fc-batch-full-20261112/before --after "$src" --downstream-repo /mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/tide-learning-lab --device "$1" --threads "$threads" --sdpa-training --output-dir "$out/$label"

limits: Full-scale benchmark strict_numerical remains not_checked; small local/scalar checks are separate.
Input tensor byte hash was not collected; fixed task archive/recipe/seeds and parameter bytes are recorded.
Per-phase times are host enqueue/calling-thread intervals, not isolated NPU kernel times.
One warmup/reset and one measured interval per point; no repeatability or peak-throughput claim.
All-inactive Full outputs stay disconnected; independent complete public graph roots are outside the direct anchor contract.
Attention pads to Qmax; dynamic nonzero/count and per-node/source work remain.
CPU and NPU selected counts differ by one; before/after counts agree within each device.

evaluation.test_policy: sealed; separate frozen finalist review only
